reason: I already ask Claude about my portfolio and then make the trades myself, and that last step is the part I'm not handing over. A cartoon pet moving my real money with no price and no named broker yet isn't something I'd sign up to pay for.
objection: I don't trust an AI with my money. Limits and a kill switch sound nice, but I'd still be finding out after the fact what it bought, and I don't know who actually holds the account.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker holding the money, plus a mode where every single trade waits for my tap, and a few months of watching it make sensible calls on the demo first.
